blocks.text: Alden Richards declared that he is a “good person” and urged others to protect their kindness amid the controversy he’s facing. Richards made the remarks as he opened the Hero For All 2026 awards ceremony on Sunday, Oct. 25, in Ortigas. “I really do believe that if there’s one thing I’m proud of, sabihin n’yo nang mayabang ako pero alam ko at the end of the day, I am a good person. No one can take that away,” he said. “And I’m sure gusto ko ganu’n din ‘yung maging mindset ng mga heroes natin, na you can be proud to tell […]...
